svg.title: Value stream map crankcase path
svg.text: 02 – Value stream map (current state, example): crankcase → compressor path, mix 30 / 50 / 20 %, VC20 cycle times
Process data from config/factory.json; WIP in triangles = typical buffer fill (assumed – read the real fill in the Live factory tab). Waiting time = WIP × takt 270 s (300 units/day, 3 × 7.5 h).
Production control: ERP (MRP every 1 h) + MES
work orders per model, release EDD, priority MTO 3 / MTS 5
pallets (10) and kanban cards limit WIP
Lead time ladder (upper = waiting, lower = process time per unit):
Lead time = 59.7 h waiting + 1760 s process = 60.2 h
Value-add only (HMC 345 + ASSY 200 + ROBOT 110 + FINAL 210 = 865 s)
raw castings (54 h) are 90 % of the lead time
Total WIP in triangles: 720 castings + 6 + 25 line buffers + 45 FG = 796 units → × 270 s = 59.7 h. In machines ≈ 12 units (counted as process time).
Future-state ideas: smaller casting lots (more deliveries), FG by heijunka (10.2), CONWIP for the line (section 20), SMED on HMC tool-set exchange (600 s).
current state, takt 270 s, WIP from typical buffer fill
